Mass-spectrometry metabolomics and lipidomics provide quantitative views of how cells and tissues
allocate resources, respond to stress and change state. These measurements are central to our
work on muscle regeneration, senescence, aging and environmental adaptation.

## Integrated measurement

Discovery and targeted measurements across cells, tissues and biofluids are interpreted alongside
imaging, functional phenotyping and experimental perturbation. This integrated approach distinguishes
molecular signatures that accompany a phenotype from metabolic changes that help drive it.
